criteria.requirement: Fix _attr_inline_rule class accumulation after link_close/span_close by resolving the matching opening Token before reading existing class. Link/image/code class blocks concatenate in declaration order without deduplication; spans preserve existing canonical repeated-attribute behavior by retaining each class word at its first position. Later id and other keys override normally. Keep single-token handling, nested inline content, neighbor isolation and allowed filtering. Do not globally concatenate nonclass attributes or mutate the closing Token instead of the rendered target.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
